lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Snail Jams.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Take your time.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: You're listening... to Snail Jams. Ninety-three point five.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Eventually.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Snail Jams. Slow jams... for slow listeners.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Good morning. It's still morning. It'll be morning for a while. Snail Jams.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Snail Jams. Good night.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: I started saying that at teatime.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: This is Snail Jams. Take everyone's time. They won't mind.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Snail...

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Jams.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Here's the traffic. On the leaf.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Heading north, one snail. Me. Moving well.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Expected at the edge of the leaf... by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: That last song was three minutes long. For us, it was most of a spring.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: I cried at the chorus. It arrived in June.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Some people say I talk too slowly.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Those people... have already left.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: More music, for everyone who stayed.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Live update. A raindrop is falling.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: It is about... halfway down.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: We'll keep you posted. Here's a song while we wait.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Raindrop update. It has landed.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: On the mushroom. The mushroom is fine.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Thank you all, for your concern.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Snail Jams is brought to you by Grumbel's Ladders.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: I've been climbing one of their ladders since spring. I'm on the first rung.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Lovely view. Grumbel's. Up is a choice.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Morning, everyone. The dew is out. I'm going to have a little sip.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: That was the sip. Here's a song.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: It's getting dark in the garden. The fireflies are on.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: One of them is blinking in time with the music.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Show-off.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: A reminder to the snail on the next leaf: your headphones are on backwards.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Don't fix it now. You'll miss the whole album.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: We've had a request. It came in last month.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: We're getting to it. We're nearly there.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Coming up... after this one, and several others.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Evening. Fast-moving weather is coming in. Very fast. A breeze.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Hold on to something. I'm holding on to the leaf.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: It's the afternoon. I've had a very busy day.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: I went all the way to the edge of the leaf.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: It was too much. I came back.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: A shadow went past this morning. Very quickly. Too quickly.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: We didn't get a name. We got half a hat.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: If it was Greg... Hollis says hello. Slow down, Greg.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Big news. There is a lettuce.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: It's over there. Don't look. We're going.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: We'll be there in the autumn.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: If you're in a rush right now, this station isn't for you. But stay. Just this once. See what happens.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Nothing. Isn't it nice.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Before you sleep, a tip from the garden.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Whatever you didn't finish today, you can carry it on your back tomorrow. That's what we do.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: It's not heavy. It's home.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: The garden forecast.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Dew. Then more dew.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: A chance of one leaf turning over, late in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: Wind: none, thank you.

lines.speaker: Shelley Shellbourne
lines.text: That's the forecast for today. And, knowing us, tomorrow.
